headline: Seasonal Park Permits and Museum Reservations
reservation: While most city parks are open for public walking, equipment rentals for kayaking or snowshoeing require independent reservations through the Minneapolis Park and Recreation Board. Popular sites like the Walker Art Center recommend advance ticketing for specific gallery rotations. Official systems change seasonally; always check the specific park or museum website for updated entry policies.

days.title: Lakeshore Paths and Modern Art
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM from Bde Maka Ska

stops.name: Chain of Lakes Regional Park
stops.detail: Cycle or walk the connected paths between Bde Maka Ska and Lake Harriet.

stops.name: Minneapolis Sculpture Garden
stops.detail: Visit the iconic Spoonbridge and Cherry sculpture in this free outdoor gallery.

days.driving: Local city driving; allow 25 minutes for lake-to-garden transfers.
days.note: Walking paths and bike lanes are separated; follow local directional markings.

days.title: Mississippi River and Industrial History
days.start: Suggested: 8:30 AM from the Mill District

stops.name: Stone Arch Bridge
stops.detail: Cross the former railroad bridge for panoramic views of St. Anthony Falls.

stops.name: Mill City Museum
stops.detail: Explore the ruins of the world's largest flour mill along the riverbank.

days.driving: Walking-heavy day; allow 15 minutes for local parking transitions.
days.note: Bridge access may be restricted for structural maintenance; check official city notices.

days.title: Cascades and Urban Wilds

stops.name: Minnehaha Regional Park
stops.detail: View the 53-foot waterfall and follow the creek trails to the Mississippi River.

stops.name: Eloise Butler Wildflower Garden
stops.detail: Wander through the oldest public wildflower garden in the United States.

days.driving: Allow 30 minutes between the falls and Theodore Wirth Park; traffic varies.
days.note: Wildflower garden hours are seasonal; typically closed in winter months.

intel.title: Lake and Falls Parking
intel.text: Pay-to-park lots are standard at Minnehaha Falls and Chain of Lakes. Use the 'Minneapolis Parking' app for easier management of street meters downtown.

intel.title: River Gorge Connectivity
intel.text: Cellular signals are strong throughout the city, though can dip slightly in the deep wooded sections of the Mississippi River Gorge trails.

intel.title: Urban Infrastructure
intel.text: Fuel stations are frequent in the city and surrounding suburbs like Bloomington. Ensure you have a full tank if heading further north into the rural river valleys.

intel.title: Skyway vs. Street
intel.text: In winter, allow extra time to navigate the Skyway system for indoor walking. Summer travel is best during mid-morning to avoid festival-related congestion.

intel.title: Trail Conditions
intel.text: Limestone trails near the river can be slippery after rain or during the spring melt. Check the Park Board website for seasonal trail closures.

plan.arrival: Pick up vehicle at MSP Airport; drive 20 minutes to downtown Minneapolis for supplies and lodging check-in.
plan.vehicle: Standard cars suffice for summer; consider AWD if visiting during winter months and check rental winter tire policies.
plan.goldenHour: Stone Arch Bridge offers views of the skyline, though clarity depends on seasonal river mist.
